Reliable history

Spreadsheet import

Bring your existing tool list over in minutes instead of starting from scratch.

Track the relationships that matter

Each tool has a current holder and location. That can be a worker, a truck, the shop, or a job site. When the tool moves, its record moves with it.

Keep maintenance from becoming a surprise

Log damage in the field, set a maintenance status, and keep equipment out of circulation until it is ready. Your tool’s history shows what happened without rewriting the past.

Unlimited field workers is included in every plan. Your crew should not have to share a login or create a pricing problem.

Frequently asked questions

Do workers need to install an app?

No. Fieldmark is designed for the browser already on their phone.

Can I import from Excel?

Yes. The import flow starts with a CSV export from your spreadsheet and maps the tool fields before saving.

Can we fix a mistaken scan?

Yes. A correction adds a transparent record rather than silently destroying the original history.
